reason: A DeepSeek Harness interface plugin focused on navigation and panel presentation, offering simplified or native display modes with grouped, expandable tool-call summaries.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供简化与原生两档界面切换，并将工具调用整理为可展开的摘要面板。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with simplified and native interface modes, organizing tool calls into expandable summary panels.

capabilities: Provides a simplified or native DeepSeek Harness interface mode
Groups and collapses tool-call displays into an expandable panel
Renders user-facing tool summaries and sanitized result details
Adds a floating interface control for switching modes
